title: Zoom In and Out
drDigitalIntro:
Zooming makes text and images bigger or smaller so they are easier to see.
• On a trackpad: spread two fingers apart to zoom in, and pinch them together to zoom out.
• On a keyboard: hold Control (or Command on a Mac) and press Plus (+) to zoom in, or Minus (-) to zoom out.
• You can zoom in on any web page, photo, or document.
• Press Control and Zero (0) — Command and Zero on a Mac — to jump back to the normal size.
• In the activity, zoom in until you can read a tiny promo code, then type it in.

playgroundTask.instructions: Open the browser. Pinch two fingers apart on the trackpad to zoom in (or tap the + button). Read the tiny promo code, then type it in the box.

drDigitalSuccess: You zoomed in far enough to read it. Nothing on a screen is too small to deal with.
drDigitalHint: Put two fingers on the trackpad and spread them apart to zoom in — or click the + button. Keep zooming until the little promo code is easy to read, then type it in.
